speaker: left
name: 분홍 토끼
text: 안녕, 언니. 오랜만이네. 열심히 일하는 거 같은데, 퇴근은 언제 해?

speaker: right
name: 언니 토끼
text: 이미 알고 있잖아. 아마 저녁 먹을 시간은 돼야 퇴근하겠지.

speaker: left
name: 분홍 토끼
text: 그래? 아, 미안한데. 언니, 할 말이 있어.

speaker: left
name: 분홍 토끼
text: 언니, 나 밖으로 나가볼거야. 세상이 어떻게 생겼는지 직접 두 눈으로 보고 싶거든!

speaker: right
name: Big Bunny
text: Um, sorry... I lost count. Which time is this again?

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: This time, it's different. I mean it.

speaker: right
name: Big Bunny
text: Oh, really? Then let’s see if you're actually ready. Otherwise, you're having dinner at home with me.

speaker: left
name: Pink Bunny
text: Keep acting relaxed, and you'll regret it!

speaker: right
name: Big Bunny
text: Hmm... Look at this little troublemaker. You're asking for it.
